summary.headline: Plan for the Greek Codices Catalog
summary.text: Prefatory account of the planned catalog of Greek astrological codices, organized by preservation site, including Marcian, Munich, Viennese, Parisian, and Roman collections. It explains the catalog’s full codex inventories, identification of anonymous excerpts and authors or editors, transcription of opening and closing words, and publication of principal fragments.
